name: com.displayxr.unity
description: Unity plugin for DisplayXR OpenXR runtime enabling stereo rendering on 3D light field displays. Provides display-centric and camera-centric stereo rig authoring, Kooima asymmetric frustum projection, 2D UI overlay support, and in-editor preview.

samples.description: Minimal camera-centric stereo setup with a few objects for testing.
URP smoke test for the stereo rig. Same content as Basic Scene; verifies the SRP camera-callback path. Requires URP installed in the host project.
Crate test scene matching the native reference app, with full stereo rig controls.
Chroma-key transparent overlay mode (issue #57) — capsule avatar floats above the desktop with click-through. Windows standalone only.

Smallest working chroma-key transparent overlay scene (~70 lines). Teaching sample — README walks through the four-mechanism pipeline, the OpenXR extensions in use, and the layer ownership map. Windows standalone only.
